text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, rivaroxaban 15 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 147 tablets (15.2 days at 9.7/day), Corvale General holds 218 tablets (22.6 days at 9.7/day), and Corvale Lakeside holds 28 tablets (12.6 days at 2.2/day). The FDA status field indicates "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows rivaroxaban is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The ranked supplier Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited labels a registered plant (FEI 3004956904) last inspected with NAI classification on 2024-07-26. That plant has a history of VAI inspections from 2010 through 2020, with the most recent VAI known date of 2020-06-11.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation protocols. The "To Be Discontinued" status without a date warrants proactive sourcing from available manufacturers not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (ranked option 1) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp., Aurobindo Pharma Limited, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Changzhou Pharmaceutical Factory as backup sources — requires buyer approval.
3. Pharmacy director to review site-specific par levels and transfer stock from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval.
4. P&T committee to monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes — requires committee chair approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until a shortage is declared; relying solely on current inventory given the discontinuation signal.
